title: High-fiber breakfast cereals using only carrot and cereal by-products
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1391-1404
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00157A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Diva Santos, Manuela Pintado, José A. Lopes da Silva
Fibre-rich cereals from carrot by-products and cereals bran were created through mild extrusion. With over 50% fibre and bioactive compounds, they support health and sustainability in a circular food system.
